requirements.title: heartbeat() resets a stream's deadline timer
requirements.text: rcp_deadline_monitor_heartbeat() shall reset the named stream's last-signal time to the current time, and shall return false without changing any state if the stream was not registered.

requirements.title: Dead event on initial deadline
requirements.text: The monitor shall emit LivenessEvent{alive=false} for any stream that receives no heartbeat within its configured deadline, including the very first deadline period.

requirements.title: Repeated dead events suppressed
requirements.text: The monitor shall not re-emit LivenessEvent{alive=false} for a stream that is already known to be dead.

requirements.title: Alive event on first heartbeat
requirements.text: The monitor shall emit LivenessEvent{alive=true} when the first heartbeat arrives for a previously-dead stream.

requirements.title: alive() reflects the most recently emitted liveness state
requirements.text: Monitor::alive(stream_id) shall return the alive value of the most recent LivenessEvent emitted for stream_id, and false for any stream not yet reported on.

requirements.title: notify_overflow() immediately declares a stream dead
requirements.text: rcp_deadline_monitor_notify_overflow() shall emit LivenessEvent{alive=false} for the named stream immediately, without waiting for its deadline timer to elapse, and shall return false without changing any state if the stream was not registered.

requirements.title: Close terminates the background thread
requirements.text: Monitor::close() shall signal the background deadline-check thread to stop and shall be idempotent.

requirements.title: Destructor joins the background thread
requirements.text: The Monitor destructor shall join the background deadline-check thread before returning.

requirements.title: rcp_deadline_default_config() returns the documented defaults
requirements.text: rcp_deadline_default_config() shall return default_deadline_ms = 50 and poll_interval_ms = 5.

requirements.title: rcp_deadline_monitor_new() initializes per-stream watch state and starts the poll thread
requirements.text: rcp_deadline_monitor_new(cfg, streams, n_streams) shall allocate a monitor tracking exactly n_streams streams, each initialized not-alive with its own deadline (streams[i].deadline_ms if nonzero, otherwise cfg.default_deadline_ms) and last_signal_ms set to the current monotonic time, and shall start the background poll thread; it shall return NULL on allocation failure.

requirements.title: rcp_deadline_monitor_alive() reports a tracked stream's liveness, false if untracked
requirements.text: rcp_deadline_monitor_alive(m, stream_id) shall return the tracked stream's current alive flag, or false when stream_id is not tracked by m.

requirements.title: rcp_deadline_monitor_subscribe() registers a liveness callback
requirements.text: rcp_deadline_monitor_subscribe(m, cb, user_data) shall register cb/user_data to be invoked on future liveness transitions and return whether registration succeeded (false only on allocation failure while growing the callback list).

requirements.title: rcp_deadline_monitor_destroy() closes the poll thread and releases every owned resource
requirements.text: rcp_deadline_monitor_destroy(m) shall be a safe no-op when m is NULL; otherwise it shall close m (joining the background poll thread if one was started) and then free its states, callbacks, and callback_ctx arrays and destroy its mutex before freeing m itself.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_CLOSED is non-zero
requirements.text: The sentinel error RCP_ERR_CLOSED shall be non-zero so callers can distinguish it from RCP_OK (success).

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND is non-zero
requirements.text: The sentinel error RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND shall be non-zero.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS is non-zero
requirements.text: The sentinel error RCP_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS shall be non-zero.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT is non-zero
requirements.text: The sentinel error RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT shall be non-zero.

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_BUSY is non-zero
requirements.text: The sentinel error RCP_ERR_BUSY shall be non-zero.

requirements.title: All sentinel errors are mutually distinct
requirements.text: RCP_ERR_CLOSED, RCP_ERR_NOT_FOUND, RCP_ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS, RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT, RCP_ERR_BUSY, RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED, and RCP_ERR_FORBIDDEN shall all be distinct rcp_errc_t values (different rcp_errc_t value).

requirements.title: RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT detectable by value comparison
requirements.text: Any return code returned due to a context deadline expiry shall compare equal to RCP_ERR_TIMEOUT.

requirements.title: rcp_strerror() returns unique human-readable message
requirements.text: rcp_strerror() shall return a unique, non-empty message for each defined rcp_errc_t constant, including RCP_OK.

requirements.title: No fault when no rules
requirements.text: rcp_faultinject_evaluate() shall return RCP_FI_PROCEED when fi currently has no active rules.

requirements.title: Drop rule returns RCP_FI_DROP
requirements.text: rcp_faultinject_evaluate() shall return RCP_FI_DROP when the oldest active rule is type RCP_FI_DROP.

requirements.title: Error rule returns RCP_FI_ERROR
requirements.text: rcp_faultinject_evaluate() shall return RCP_FI_ERROR when the oldest active rule is type RCP_FI_ERROR.

requirements.title: Slow rule reports the configured latency
requirements.text: rcp_faultinject_evaluate() shall return RCP_FI_SLOW and write the rule's latency_ms into *out_latency_ms when the oldest active rule is type RCP_FI_SLOW.

requirements.title: Count-based rule expires after N firings
requirements.text: A rule added with count == N > 0 shall fire on exactly its next N rcp_faultinject_evaluate() calls and then be removed, so the (N+1)th call evaluates the next rule (or RCP_FI_PROCEED).

requirements.title: clear_rules() removes all active rules
requirements.text: rcp_faultinject_clear_rules() shall remove every rule from fi's list, so the next rcp_faultinject_evaluate() call returns RCP_FI_PROCEED.

requirements.title: Timeout rule returns RCP_FI_TIMEOUT
requirements.text: rcp_faultinject_evaluate() shall return RCP_FI_TIMEOUT when the oldest active rule is type RCP_FI_TIMEOUT.

requirements.title: Rules are evaluated in FIFO order
requirements.text: rcp_faultinject_evaluate() shall pick the oldest still-active rule in fi's list (the first one added that has not yet expired), not an arbitrary or most-recent one.

requirements.title: add_rule() is safe concurrently with evaluate()
requirements.text: rcp_faultinject_add_rule() shall be safe to call concurrently with rcp_faultinject_evaluate()/rcp_faultinject_clear_rules() from other threads.

requirements.title: destroy() frees every tracked rule
requirements.text: rcp_faultinject_destroy() shall free fi's rule storage, then fi itself, without leaking.

requirements.title: rcp_faultinject_new() allocates an injector with no rules
requirements.text: rcp_faultinject_new() shall return a heap-allocated rcp_faultinject_t with no rules registered and its own mutex initialized, or NULL on allocation failure.

requirements.title: rcp_faultinject_clear_rules() removes every registered rule without freeing the injector
requirements.text: rcp_faultinject_clear_rules(fi) shall remove every rule previously added via rcp_faultinject_add_rule(), leaving fi itself allocated and usable for further rcp_faultinject_add_rule() calls.

requirements.title: Permitted identity/addr/request-type combination succeeds
requirements.text: rcp_authz_policy_permit() shall return true for an identity, address, and request_type matching an entry added via rcp_authz_policy_allow().

requirements.title: Denied identity is not permitted
requirements.text: rcp_authz_policy_permit() shall return false for an identity with no matching policy entry (default-deny).

requirements.title: Empty addrs/request_types set means all allowed
requirements.text: rcp_authz_policy_allow() with n_addrs == 0 and/or n_request_types == 0 shall be treated as a wildcard over that dimension.

requirements.title: AccessPolicy permits concurrently without data races
requirements.text: rcp_authz_policy_permit() shall be safe to call concurrently with other rcp_authz_policy_permit()/rcp_authz_policy_allow() calls.

requirements.title: A listed address must match both stream_id and byte_bus_id
requirements.text: rcp_authz_policy_permit() shall return false when addr differs from every address in a matching entry's addrs list, even if only one of stream_id/byte_bus_id differs.

requirements.title: A listed request_type must match exactly
requirements.text: rcp_authz_policy_permit() shall return false when request_type is not present in a matching entry's request_types list (and that list is non-empty).

requirements.title: An identity with no matching entry is permitted nothing
requirements.text: rcp_authz_policy_permit() shall return false for any (addr, request_type) when identity does not match any rcp_authz_policy_allow() entry's identity.

requirements.title: allow() copies its addrs/request_types arrays by value
requirements.text: rcp_authz_policy_allow() shall copy the addrs and request_types arrays passed to it; mutating the caller's arrays after the call shall not affect the stored policy entry.

requirements.title: rcp_authz_policy_new() allocates a policy with refcount 1; retain/release tolerate NULL
requirements.text: rcp_authz_policy_new() shall return a heap-allocated rcp_authz_policy_t with refcount 1, no entries, and its own mutex initialized, or NULL on allocation failure. rcp_authz_policy_retain(NULL) shall return NULL without dereferencing it; rcp_authz_policy_release(NULL) shall be a safe no-op.

requirements.title: rcp_authz_policy_retain() increments the refcount and returns its argument unchanged
requirements.text: rcp_authz_policy_retain(p) shall increment p's refcount and return p unchanged, so that `p = rcp_authz_policy_retain(p)` is a valid idiom.

requirements.title: rcp_authz_policy_release() frees only once the refcount reaches zero
requirements.text: rcp_authz_policy_release(p) shall decrement p's refcount and free p (its mutex, every entry's owned addrs/request_types arrays, and its own entries array) only once the refcount reaches zero; a policy retained more than once shall remain fully usable after any release that leaves its refcount above zero.

requirements.title: record() produces a span with every field populated
requirements.text: rcp_observe_record() shall build an rcp_span_t with the given name, addr, request_type, start_ms, end_ms, and result, and pass it to sink.record_span().

requirements.title: Multiple record() calls accumulate spans in order
requirements.text: Repeated rcp_observe_record() calls against an InMemorySink shall accumulate spans in call order, retrievable via rcp_in_memory_sink_spans().

requirements.title: Span duration is non-negative
requirements.text: rcp_span_duration_ms() shall never return a value that would be negative if interpreted as signed, since end_ms >= start_ms for every span this module produces.

requirements.title: Span captures the caller-supplied result code
requirements.text: The result field of the rcp_span_t built by rcp_observe_record() shall equal the result argument passed to it.

requirements.title: Noop sink does not crash
requirements.text: Every callback in rcp_noop_metrics_sink()'s vtable shall be safe to call with any valid arguments and shall have no observable side effect.

requirements.title: InMemorySink is thread-safe under concurrent recording
requirements.text: rcp_in_memory_sink_t's record_span callback shall be safe to call concurrently from multiple threads without losing or corrupting entries.

requirements.title: rcp.requests.total counter fires once per record() call
requirements.text: rcp_observe_record() shall call sink.record_counter("rcp.requests.total", ...) exactly once per invocation, regardless of result.

requirements.title: rcp.requests.errors counter fires only when result != RCP_OK
requirements.text: rcp_observe_record() shall call sink.record_counter("rcp.requests.errors", ...) iff result != RCP_OK.

requirements.title: Span captures the addr it was recorded with
requirements.text: The addr field of the rcp_span_t built by rcp_observe_record() shall equal the addr argument passed to it.

requirements.title: Span captures the request_type it was recorded with
requirements.text: The request_type field of the rcp_span_t built by rcp_observe_record() shall equal the request_type argument passed to it.

requirements.title: Span captures the name it was recorded with
requirements.text: The name field of the rcp_span_t built by rcp_observe_record() shall equal the name argument passed to it.

requirements.title: endpoints() returns a snapshot of registered endpoints
requirements.text: rcp_admin_server_endpoints() shall fill out[] with every endpoint currently registered via rcp_admin_server_register_endpoint(), each marked registered = true.

requirements.title: register/deregister report whether membership actually changed
requirements.text: rcp_admin_server_register_endpoint()/rcp_admin_server_deregister_endpoint() shall return true iff the call actually changed srv's registered-endpoint set, false for a redundant call.

requirements.title: subscribe() registers a callback invoked by emit()
requirements.text: rcp_admin_server_subscribe() shall register cb such that a subsequent rcp_admin_server_emit() call invokes it.

requirements.title: emit() delivers to all subscribers with the correct event
requirements.text: rcp_admin_server_emit(srv, ev) shall invoke every subscriber registered via rcp_admin_server_subscribe(), in registration order, each with a copy of ev unchanged (type, addr, ts_ms).

requirements.title: record_counter() accumulates every delta exactly once
requirements.text: Repeated rcp_admin_server_record_counter() calls for the same (name, labels) pair shall sum their delta arguments into a single running total.

requirements.title: metrics_text() renders Prometheus-format counter lines
requirements.text: rcp_admin_server_metrics_text() shall render each tracked counter as a "# TYPE <name> counter" line followed by a "<name>{<labels>} <value>" (or "<name> <value>" when labels is empty) line.

requirements.title: Distinct name+labels combinations are tracked separately
requirements.text: rcp_admin_server_record_counter() calls with the same name but different labels (or vice versa) shall be tracked as independent running totals.

requirements.title: AdminServer tolerates concurrent mutation without data races
requirements.text: rcp_admin_server_register_endpoint()/_deregister_endpoint()/record_counter() shall be safe to call concurrently from multiple threads.

requirements.title: rcp_admin_server_new() allocates a zero-initialized server
requirements.text: rcp_admin_server_new() shall return a heap-allocated rcp_admin_server_t with no endpoints, subscribers, or counters registered, and its own mutex initialized; it shall return NULL on allocation failure.

requirements.title: rcp_admin_server_destroy() releases every owned resource
requirements.text: rcp_admin_server_destroy() shall be a safe no-op when srv is NULL; otherwise it shall destroy srv's mutex and free its endpoints, subscribers, and counters arrays before freeing srv itself.

requirements.title: capture() appends an entry
requirements.text: rcp_recorder_capture() shall append one rcp_recorder_entry_t to r, increasing rcp_recorder_size(r) by 1, on success.

requirements.title: Multiple captures produce sequential entries in order
requirements.text: Successive rcp_recorder_capture() calls shall produce entries retrievable via rcp_recorder_entries() in the same order they were captured.

requirements.title: write_binary() creates a non-empty file
requirements.text: rcp_recorder_write_binary() shall, on RCP_OK, have written a file at path whose size is greater than zero for a non-empty recorder.

requirements.title: Playback invokes deliver() for every entry, in order
requirements.text: rcp_playback_run_all() shall call deliver exactly once per entry in rec, in the same order the entries were captured.

requirements.title: speed_factor of 0 disables inter-entry delays
requirements.text: rcp_playback_run_all() shall not sleep between deliveries when cfg.speed_factor <= 0.0, regardless of the entries' recorded timestamp gaps.

requirements.title: capture() copies the frame bytes by value
requirements.text: rcp_recorder_capture() shall copy frame[0..frame_len) into storage it owns; mutating the caller's buffer after the call shall not affect the stored entry.

requirements.title: capture() records addr and inbound correctly
requirements.text: The addr and inbound fields of the entry appended by rcp_recorder_capture() shall equal the addr and inbound arguments passed to it.

requirements.title: Record tolerates concurrent captures
requirements.text: rcp_recorder_capture() shall be safe to call concurrently from multiple threads without losing or corrupting entries.

requirements.title: entries() honors the cap parameter while reporting the true total
requirements.text: rcp_recorder_entries(r, out, cap) shall write at most cap entries into out but shall always return r's true total entry count.

requirements.title: write_binary() returns RCP_ERR_BUSY when the path cannot be opened
requirements.text: rcp_recorder_write_binary() shall return RCP_ERR_BUSY, without crashing, when path cannot be opened for writing.

requirements.title: destroy() frees every captured entry
requirements.text: rcp_recorder_destroy() shall free every entry's frame buffer and the entries array itself, then r, without leaking.

requirements.title: rcp_recorder_new() allocates an empty recorder
requirements.text: rcp_recorder_new() shall return a heap-allocated rcp_recorder_t with no entries recorded and its own mutex initialized, or NULL on allocation failure.

requirements.title: rcp_recorder_size() reports the number of entries recorded so far
requirements.text: rcp_recorder_size(r) shall return the number of entries recorded into r since its creation.

requirements.title: rcp_playback_default_config() returns the documented default
requirements.text: rcp_playback_default_config() shall return speed_factor = 1.0.

requirements.title: hw_pin_map entries require a numeric hw_ep_nr
requirements.text: rcp_config_parse_json() shall reject a hw_pin_map entry missing a numeric hw_ep_nr field with RCP_CFG_ERR_PARSE.

requirements.title: hw_pin_map entries require a numeric hw_ep_pin_nr
requirements.text: rcp_config_parse_json() shall reject a hw_pin_map entry missing a numeric hw_ep_pin_nr field with RCP_CFG_ERR_PARSE.

requirements.title: hw_pin_map entries parse the optional pin_property name array
requirements.text: rcp_config_parse_json() shall OR together the RCP_REGMAP_PIN_PROP_* bit named by each recognized string in a hw_pin_map entry's optional pin_property array into that entry's pin_property field, leaving it 0 when the array is absent.

requirements.title: endpoint entries require numeric byte_bus_id and ep_type
requirements.text: rcp_config_parse_json() shall reject an endpoints entry missing a numeric byte_bus_id or ep_type field with RCP_CFG_ERR_PARSE.

requirements.title: endpoint entries parse the optional ep_enable flag
requirements.text: rcp_config_parse_json() shall set an endpoints entry's ep_enable field from its optional ep_enable boolean, defaulting to false when absent.

requirements.title: stream entries require rx_stream_id; configured defaults to true
requirements.text: rcp_config_parse_json() shall reject a streams entry missing a numeric rx_stream_id field with RCP_CFG_ERR_PARSE, and shall set its configured field from the optional configured boolean, defaulting to true for an entry that is otherwise present.

requirements.title: bridge_send() returns RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED when stub
requirements.text: Until a concrete gRPC backend is linked, rcp_grpc_bridge_send() shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED rather than attempting an unconfigured transmission, and shall leave *out_response untouched.

requirements.title: default_config() returns documented defaults
requirements.text: rcp_grpc_default_config() shall return this module's documented default configuration values.

requirements.title: bridge_send() returns RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED when stub
requirements.text: Until a concrete HTTP backend is linked, rcp_rest_bridge_send() shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED rather than attempting an unconfigured transmission, and shall leave *out_response untouched.

requirements.title: default_config() returns documented defaults
requirements.text: rcp_rest_default_config() shall return this module's documented default configuration values.

requirements.title: bridge_send() returns RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED when stub
requirements.text: Until a concrete SOME/IP backend is linked, rcp_someip_bridge_send() shall return RCP_ERR_NOT_SUPPORTED rather than attempting an unconfigured transmission, and shall leave *out_response untouched.

requirements.title: default_config() returns documented defaults
requirements.text: rcp_someip_default_config() shall return this module's documented default configuration values.
